messages:
emma_marketing: quick ask: marketing needs a tiny reproducible bench pack + method blurb for a launch stat: "roughly 2x savings per token using 4-bit quant + workload-aware batching". deadline = Fri AM for blog + webinar slide. can runtime run a compact smoke?

rory_runtime: yes. recommend 3 cohorts (short ~30, medium ~140, long ~450). hardware = 1x A100, compare fp16 vs 4-bit quant. we'll capture p50/p95/p99, throughput @ conc 1/4/8, and a coldstart trace.

nina_eng: warmup plan: 40 short, 10 medium, then measured runs. repeats=4. export per-request CSV (id, cohort, seq_len, latency_ms, tokens_out, model_id, quant_mode). include 5 sample traces per cohort.

emma_marketing: please also include a 2-sentence method note we can paste into the blog and one short caveat list for legal. marketing will tag quant numbers as "initial" if tuning not complete.

rory_runtime: noted. we'll run default quant kernels first (label = initial-quant). if time allows we'll do a quick tuning pass (+~2h) and post updated artifacts. seed=1234 for reproducibility; sample payload: {"input":"Briefly describe Redwood Inference for a product blog.","max_tokens":80,"temperature":0.0,"seed":1234}.

bench-bot: CI job created: https://ci.internal/run/1725000000-smoke. started 1725000040. ETA ~60m.

bench-bot: job finished. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1725000000/initial_smoke.tar.gz (csv + traces + logs).

rory_runtime: uploaded fp16 tuned runs to s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1725000000/fp16_tuned/. quant4 runs are initial: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1725000000/quant4_initial/. we'll post a short method blurb and a minimal reproduce script in the same folder.

legal-bot: suggested caveat text: "Benchmarks run on internal hardware with controlled inputs; results may vary by workload and deployment. Numbers labeled 'initial' may improve after kernel tuning."

emma_marketing: perfect. marketing will draft the blog line and slide copy. please flag here if you post tuned quant artifacts. thanks all! :sparkles:
